name: dsh-meta-community
description: The community half of the Web4 meta layer: a recognised set of independently operated harness instances that fuse their meta-packages under MULTIPLE authenticated authors, carry the owner's five clauses as machine-readable data, and hold a standing conformance check that goes RED when a clause has no artifact behind it.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify
scripts.test: node src/host/verify/host-half.mjs && node src/node/verify/node-half.mjs && node src/node/verify/consensus-unit.mjs
